data_description.host: IP address or hostname of your BT Home Hub 5.

legacy_known_devices.description:
BT Home Hub 5 now creates its own device tracker entities, but the following entries left over from the old YAML setup still exist in `{path}` for devices tracked by the router at `{host}`:

{devices}

These legacy trackers are no longer updated and will show as away.

Remove these entries from `{path}`, update any automations that use them to the new entities, and restart Home Assistant.
legacy_known_devices.title: Remove leftover known devices for BT Home Hub 5

yaml_import_cannot_connect.description:
The YAML configuration for BT Home Hub 5 at `{host}` could not be imported.

Check that `{host}` is a reachable BT Home Hub 5, update your `configuration.yaml` if needed, and restart Home Assistant.
yaml_import_cannot_connect.title: YAML configuration import failed
